div.div:
Normal
Clients query the local inbound endpoint (first DNS server). BIND forwards to the local endpoint first. Answers come from the local region (whoami 10.255.1.1 in r1).

div.div:
Failover
Local inbound endpoint unreachable → clients and BIND retry the remote endpoint across hub peering via the NVAs. Linux ≈ 5 s, Windows 17–56 s, BIND < 1 s worst gap; 100% success.

div.div:
Failback
When the local endpoint returns, the next queries use the first DNS server again – no manual action, no sticky state, no zone or ruleset changes.
